nights.title: Pa Sheehy - The Magic We Found Tour
nights.name: Pa Sheehy
nights.extract: Patrick "Pa" Sheehy is an Irish singer-songwriter from Dingle, County Kerry.

nights.title: Todd Kessler
nights.name: Todd Kessler
nights.description: American film and television writer, producer and director
nights.extract: Todd Kessler is an American film and television writer, producer and director. Among his credits are showrunner and co-creator of Nickelodeon's preschool series Blue's Clues and director and producer of the feature film Keith (2008).

nights.title: SiM - Hooman After All World Tour
nights.name: SiM
nights.extract: SiM are a Japanese metalcore band from Kanagawa Prefecture formed in 2004. The band currently consists of MAH (vocals), SHOW-HATE (guitar), SIN (bass), and GODRi (drums). Their musical style mixes nu metal, alternative, hip-hop, ska, reggae, dub, and punk with rebellious lyrics and songs with attitude.

nights.title: THE SILOS
nights.name: The Silos
nights.extract: The Silos is an American rock band formed by Walter Salas-Humara and Bob Rupe in New York City, United States, in 1985.

nights.title: BOMBARGO – Love, In Spite of Everything TOUR!
nights.name: Bombargo
nights.extract: Bombargo is an independent pop band from Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, formed in 2013 by Nathan Thoen and Spencer Chilliak.
